title: Debug Capture
acceptance_oracle: When the existing local mock browser flow fails with opt-in enabled, write bounded screenshot/structural-DOM/URL/console-error/network-error/current-step diagnostics while keeping content redacted; preserve REVIEW_REQUIRED and SUBMISSION_UNCONFIRMED semantics. With the runtime option omitted, debug capture remains disabled.

implementation.default: OFF (Compose renders 0 for worker, source-worker, document-worker)
implementation.capture_scope: Existing local mock ATS Playwright flow only; files are stored beneath the private configured output directory per application and attempt.
privacy: Screenshot reuses the accepted privacy helper: visible text, controls, and embedded media are hidden; failure capture is viewport-only and timeout-bounded.
DOM artifact contains allowlisted structural element/ARIA-role counts only; page text, attributes, and control values are omitted.
URL credentials, query, fragment, and path identifiers are removed; path shape is retained.
Console captures only error-level messages; console/page/network messages are represented by process-keyed HMAC fingerprints and bounded lengths, never raw message strings.
Per-application retention is capped at 30 days and 20 managed attempt directories; event count is capped at 50 and screenshot file at 5 MiB.
Diagnostic write failures are best-effort and do not replace the original browser error.
implementation.submission_safety: Synthetic browser tests show a pre-submit failure remains REVIEW_REQUIRED, missing post-submit receipt remains SUBMISSION_UNCONFIRMED, and re-entry does not submit twice.
implementation.limitation: No real ATS/browser adapter exists in this accepted local product surface. Requirement remains PARTIAL until applicable real-browser adapters and broader capture surfaces are covered.
